_comment: Settings declared in config.example.json that no code reads yet. Each entry needs a reason. Wire the setting and delete the entry, or delete the setting. Enforced by scripts/check_config_wiring.py, which also fails when an entry here becomes wired, so this file cannot drift out of date. This list is the backlog of governance the config promises but the system does not implement.

unwired.github_bus.phase3.github_app: GitHub App auth mode is phase 3 and unimplemented; the bus authenticates through the gh CLI.
unwired.github_bus.phase3.cloud_relay.enabled: Cloud relay is phase 3 and unimplemented; nothing posts to it.
unwired.branch_workflow.publish_branch_prefix: The publish/release pipeline was never built. No code creates publish branches.
unwired.branch_workflow.main_branch: Code resolves the promotion target through github_bus.default_branch instead, so this value is inert and the two can disagree silently.
unwired.branch_workflow.nightly_publish: Nightly publish was never built; no scheduler reads this block.
unwired.branch_workflow.environments: Deployment environments are hardcoded in .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml and deploy-staging.yml; nothing reads them from config.
unwired.branch_workflow.promote: Promotion is implemented entirely in .github/workflows/promote-dev-to-main.yml. No orchestrator code reads this block, so the config and the workflow can disagree without anything noticing.
unwired.branch_workflow.promote.target_branch: Promotion is implemented in .github/workflows/promote-dev-to-main.yml, which does not read this config.
unwired.branch_workflow.task_pr: Container for the task PR policy below.
unwired.branch_workflow.task_pr.target_branch: PR #611 wires this into github_bus.task_pr_base_branch(). Delete this entry when #611 merges -- the guard fails until it is removed.
unwired.branch_workflow.task_pr.auto_merge: No code auto-merges task PRs; merges happen through ReviewBus approval or by hand.
unwired.branch_workflow.task_pr.required_status_: Required checks are defined by GitHub branch protection on dev, not from config. The two lists are maintained independently and already differ.
unwired.branch_workflow.task_pr.max_open_hours: Nothing tracks how long a task PR stays open. #588 sat for over a day and #589 for two days with no signal.
unwired.branch_workflow.drift_alarms: The drift detection this block describes was never implemented. Its absence is why the main/dev divergence and the stalled task PRs above went unnoticed until inspected by hand.
unwired.branch_workflow.orchestrator_sync_webhoo: Disabled by default and never implemented; no code posts to it.
